e: Oopiri balances its emotional core with enough entertainment to avoid becoming a much heavier experience. Nagarjuna nails the role, Karthi’s innocent expressions are a major asset and I loved Prakash Raj’s character. I had no issue with the remake being faithful; the team deserves credit for bringing a good French story naturally to Telugu audiences.
body:
Falls just short of being a GREAT movie and ends up firmly in the VERY NICE category!!!!!

Vamshi Paidipally makes sure there is enough entertainment around the emotional story; without that balance, the film could easily have become a much heavier experience in the space of Guzaarish.

Performance-wise, Nagarjuna nails it.

Karthi’s innocent expressions are a huge asset to the storyline, and I especially loved the way Prakash Raj’s character is written and performed.

I know some intellectuals will immediately start discussing how many scenes are copied directly from the French original.

WHO CARES!!!!!

We have seen enough examples where even a scene-to-scene remake gets badly messed up.

The team deserves appreciation for taking a good French story and bringing it effectively to a Telugu audience.

Not every viewer is blessed with special powers to effortlessly watch and understand French, Spanish, Romanian, Korean or English films 😄

Many of us simply enjoy experiencing a good story in our own language.

When I walked out of the theatre, I definitely had the feeling that I had watched a very nice movie.

At the same time, there was still that small feeling that… something was missing.
